notes: One discovery candidate was preserved for compact validation: transaction-shaped Silent Payments inputs can trigger up to 2,323 complete scans across every transaction output, with additional label-candidate elliptic-curve work and callbacks.

The repository benchmark explicitly constructs a 23,250-output worst-case scanning attack and reverses matching outputs to maximize work; discovery does not decide whether the protocol bound and realistic runtime make this acceptable.

No other plausible candidate crossed the resolved threat boundary. Extreme caller-selected counts outside transaction realism remain embedder-limited, trusted callbacks remain trusted, and forged opaque objects or invalid pointers are documented API-contract violations.
Static test/vector data were reviewed with their consuming tests and implementations; no unreviewable binary or generated item remained.
